128.73487,-15.77647.name: DIR 203 — Cotton (Gossypium hirsutum L.) field trial (site 12), Shire of Wyndham-East Kimberley
128.73487,-15.77647.type: Cotton (Gossypium hirsutum L.), licensed field trial
128.73487,-15.77647.desc: WHAT. A licensed GMO crop field trial site, Herbicide tolerance and insect resistance, held by Monsanto Australia Pty Ltd. WHERE IT SITS. OGTR named the council area this site is in and published no coordinate on the page this was read from, so this marker sits in that council area and not at the trial itself. WHY IT MATTERS. OGTR names the council area of every licensed site, its area in hectares and the licence it runs under. No other register on this map states where a release is at all, which is the comparison worth making even at this resolution.

-97.36400,31.07760.name: Scott & White Clinic-Temple
-97.36400,31.07760.desc: A fertility clinic reporting to the CDC's National ART Surveillance System. Medical director: Gordon W. Bates, MD. A fertility clinic is where human embryos are made, selected and stored, and where assisted reproduction happens, like IVF, ICSI, egg and sperm donation, freezing embryos and eggs for later. Reporting is required of every US clinic performing assisted reproduction, under the Fertility Clinic Success Rate and Certification Act, so this is close to a complete register rather than a list of members. What it records is cycles started, which is not the same as children born.

-121.95023,38.26926.name: Clinical Investigation Facility
-121.95023,38.26926.desc: An organisation accredited by AAALAC International for its care and use of laboratory animals. Part of 60th Medical Group (AMC). Accreditation is voluntary and paid for, so this is a list of organisations that chose to be inspected rather than a register of everyone doing the work. An organisation absent from it is not accredited; that says nothing about whether it uses animals. In several countries the largest users are absent for exactly that reason. The directory gives a city and country and no street address, so this point marks where the organisation is registered rather than the building where animals are held.

-113.53804,53.49274.name: Prairie Swine Centre, University of Saskatchewan
-113.53804,53.49274.status: Certificate of GAP Last visit: regular, June 2025
-113.53804,53.49274.desc: An institution certified by the Canadian Council on Animal Care for its use of animals in science. Certificate of GAP Last visit: regular, June 2025. CCAC certification is a condition of federal research funding rather than a licence, so an institution outside it is not necessarily outside the work — it may simply not take federal money. The CCAC publishes names and certificate status and no addresses, so this point marks the institution rather than the building where animals are held.

-79.04466,-2.90102.name: BIOGEPA - Centro de ReproducciÃ³n Humana
-79.04466,-2.90102.desc: A centre accredited by REDLARA, the Latin American Network of Assisted Reproduction. Website: http://biogepafertilidad.com. A fertility clinic is where human embryos are made, selected and stored, and where assisted reproduction happens, like IVF, ICSI, egg and sperm donation, freezing embryos and eggs for later. REDLARA accreditation is voluntary and its members report to a shared registry, which is why Latin America can be read at all — most countries in the region have no national register of clinics. What it is not is a complete list: a clinic outside REDLARA appears nowhere.

139.40156,35.74466.name: Murayama Annex, National Institute of Infectious Diseases (NIID)
139.40156,35.74466.company: Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare
139.40156,35.74466.desc: A BSL4 laboratory, operational. Run by Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare. It is categorised as a public health laboratory, working on human health. Personnel work in glove box. Operational or announced: 2015. It stands in a built-up area, with more than fifty thousand people living within two and a half miles. There is no international register of laboratories at this containment level and no obligation to declare one, so this record comes from a research project rather than a regulator. What that project could not find out is absent here too.

-43.24400,-22.87600.name: Bio-Manguinhos / Fiocruz
-43.24400,-22.87600.state: Rio de Janeiro — Fundação Oswaldo Cruz
-43.24400,-22.87600.desc: The immunobiologicals institute of Brazil's public health foundation, and one of two Latin American partners in the mRNA transfer programme. In 2021 it supplied more than 233 million doses of vaccines, including 153 million doses of a recombinant COVID-19 vaccine produced under a partnership with AstraZeneca. Both halves matter: it manufactures another company's recombinant product at enormous scale under licence, and it is simultaneously learning to build an mRNA platform it would own. A state manufacturer that is both licensee and would-be developer is a different actor from either a multinational or a contract manufacturer, and this map has very few of them.

106.90000,-6.30000.name: Vaksindo
106.90000,-6.30000.state: Indonesia — part of the Japfa Comfeed group
106.90000,-6.30000.desc: The first animal vaccine manufacturer in Indonesia, producing livestock vaccines mainly for poultry used in hatcheries, breeding farms and commercial farms — and, by its own description, a strategic link in the value chain of the feed and protein group that owns it. That ownership is the point. Elsewhere in this facet a vaccine maker sells to farms it does not own; here the manufacturer, the feed supplier and the farming operation are one group, in the country with one of the largest poultry sectors in Southeast Asia. Vertical integration decides what gets vaccinated against and when, without any purchase decision being made at the farm at all.
